chapters.title: The FDE Role and Decision Authority
chapters.desc: What a Forward Deployed Engineer owns, what to decide alone and what to escalate.

chapters.title: Technical Discovery: Understanding a Client's Infrastructure
chapters.desc: A structured discovery process, questionnaires and how to read an unfamiliar environment.

chapters.title: Security and Architecture Questions to Ask
chapters.desc: The question bank, why each matters and what the answers tell you.

chapters.title: Identifying Infrastructure Risks and Assessing Security Posture
chapters.desc: Finding risk through documentation, configuration review and interviews, never through unauthorised testing.

chapters.title: Choosing a Hosting Architecture and Estimating Costs
chapters.desc: Decision framework across managed services, containers and serverless, with cost modelling.

chapters.title: Integration Constraints and Integrating with Client Systems
chapters.desc: Legacy APIs, SSO, data formats, network restrictions and change-averse teams.

chapters.title: Handling Client Credentials and Sensitive Data
chapters.desc: Receiving, storing, using and destroying credentials; working with regulated data.

chapters.title: Designing Tenant Isolation
chapters.desc: Choosing an isolation model, enforcing it in every layer, and testing it.

chapters.title: Deploying into Client-Owned Cloud Accounts
chapters.desc: Cross-account roles, least privilege, IaC ownership, guardrails and exit strategy.

chapters.title: Environment Configuration and Deployment Documentation
chapters.desc: Configuration matrices, secrets inventories, runbooks and deploy procedures a stranger can follow.

chapters.title: Production Readiness Reviews and Rollback Plans
chapters.desc: Running a PRR, go/no-go criteria and rollback plans that have been rehearsed.

chapters.title: Technical Handovers
chapters.desc: Knowledge transfer that sticks: artefacts, sessions, shadowing and acceptance.

chapters.title: Troubleshooting Production Incidents at a Client
chapters.desc: Working an incident in someone else's environment with limited access and high stakes.

chapters.title: Communicating Technical Tradeoffs to Non-Technical Stakeholders
chapters.desc: Framing risk, cost and time; sample conversations and written updates.

parts.title: Hands-On Production Projects
parts.desc: Six increasingly sophisticated projects: a secure server, a production-ready backend, a Dockerized stack, an AWS deployment, a multi-tenant SaaS and an incident simulator, each with verification, security checks, troubleshooting and cleanup.

chapters.title: Project 1: Secure Linux Server
chapters.desc: Provision a VM, lock down SSH, firewall it, serve HTTPS, run a service under systemd and monitor it.

chapters.title: Project 2: Production-Ready Backend
chapters.desc: A FastAPI API with authentication, authorization, PostgreSQL, migrations, configuration, logging and tests.

chapters.title: Project 3: Dockerized Application
chapters.desc: Containerise frontend, backend and database with networking, volumes, secrets and a reverse proxy.

chapters.title: Project 4: AWS Production Deployment
chapters.desc: Deploy with a VPC, ALB, TLS, private subnets, RDS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and automated deploys.

chapters.title: Project 5: Multi-Tenant Client SaaS
chapters.desc: Multiple customers, data separation, background jobs, monitoring, backups and incident procedures.

chapters.title: Project 6: Production Incident Simulator
chapters.desc: Break things on purpose: failing health checks, connection exhaustion, permissions, secrets and latency.

chapters.title: Architecture Decision Record Examples
